title: Perform Hospital Station Daily Preventive Maintenance Checks (Barcode Scanner, Stacklight, Tabletop Debris)
summary: Perform a daily physical inspection of each Hospital Station to verify the barcode scanner is operational, the stacklight is operational, and the tabletop is free of debris.
when_to_use: Use this procedure at the start of each day (daily preventive maintenance) to confirm each Hospital Station is safe/ready for operation by checking: (1) barcode scanner operational status, (2) stacklight operational status, and (3) tabletop debris-free condition.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the physical/visual checks at each Hospital Station and stop/escalate if any required condition is not met.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to each hospital station

access_required: Physical access to each hospital station

visual_references.description: Hospital Station layout showing the green scanner location and induct/extract sides (used to orient where to inspect).
Photo of the three-segment stacklight assembly (used to visually recognize the stacklight hardware during inspection).
Tote Initialization Procedure (Zebra scanner) showing scanner behavior (green flash vs yellow flash) that can help interpret scanner operational behavior during checks.

steps.title: Inspect each Hospital Station barcode scanner and confirm it is operational
steps.purpose: Ensure the Hospital Station barcode scanner is ready to read tote barcodes for station operations.
steps.instruction: For each Hospital Station, visually inspect the barcode scanner and confirm it is operational.
steps.expected_result: For the station being inspected, the barcode scanner is operational.
steps.healthy_condition: Barcode scanner is operational at the Hospital Station.
steps.failure_condition: Barcode scanner is not operational at the Hospital Station.

actions.label: Visual check scanner operational status
actions.exact_action: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The barcode scanner is operational.

steps.title: Inspect each Hospital Station stacklight and confirm it is operational
steps.purpose: Ensure the Hospital Station stacklight is ready to provide operational status indication.
steps.instruction: For each Hospital Station, visually inspect the stacklight and confirm it is operational.
steps.expected_result: For the station being inspected, the stacklight is operational.
steps.healthy_condition: Stacklight is operational at the Hospital Station.
steps.failure_condition: Stacklight is not operational at the Hospital Station.

actions.label: Visual check stacklight operational status
actions.exact_action: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The stacklight is operational.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.1.2: HOSPITAL STATION Inspect each hospital station for the following: The stacklight is operational.

steps.title: Inspect each Hospital Station tabletop and confirm it is free of debris
steps.purpose: Ensure the tabletop area is clear so totes and station operations are not obstructed by debris.
steps.instruction: For each Hospital Station, visually inspect the tabletop area and confirm it is free of debris.
steps.expected_result: For the station being inspected, the tabletop is free of debris.
steps.healthy_condition: Tabletop is free of debris at the Hospital Station.
steps.failure_condition: Debris is present on the tabletop at the Hospital Station.

actions.label: Visual check tabletop debris-free condition
actions.exact_action: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The tabletop is free of debris.

stop_or_escalate_if: Debris is found on the tabletop

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.1.2: HOSPITAL STATION Inspect each hospital station for the following: The tabletop is free of debris.

steps.title: Stop inspection and escalate if any required condition fails
steps.purpose: Prevent operation with an unsafe/incorrectly functioning station.
steps.instruction: If any barcode scanner issue is observed, if the stacklight is not operational, or if debris is present on the tabletop, stop the inspection and escalate to maintenance/support as required by site practice.
steps.expected_result: Inspection is stopped for the day/sequence and escalation is initiated when any required condition fails.
steps.healthy_condition: No escalation is required because all three conditions (scanner operational, stacklight operational, tabletop debris-free) are met for the station(s) inspected.
steps.failure_condition: At least one required condition fails (scanner not operational, stacklight not operational, or debris present), and inspection continues without escalation.

actions.label: Stop and escalate
